TO ADD A LECTURE

3. Run quarto render, then commit and push.

::: {.ws-intro}
Since 2018 I have given invited lectures on statistical computing with R at universities, colleges and national training programmes. The **slides** for each lecture are below. The **R code and data** are available on request: use the *Request code & data* button on a lecture to send me an email.
:::
